steps.content: Exuberant colors, bright light, clinking glasses... You have had no idea what an upmarket auction looks like until you're in one now.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. Welcome to the annual charity auction.
McQueen, who is standing on stage, clears her throat.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Each and every guest here is an outstanding figure in their respective field. More importantly, each of you has left a mark on Eastside's art world.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Among you are established artists...

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Rising stars...

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: And sharp-eyed collectors, who represent the height of taste in Eastside.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Without your hard work, God knows how many masterpieces would still be gathering dust in the dark, and how many aspiring, talented artists would still be left in obscurity.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen, please give yourselves a round of applause. Thank You!
McQueen fawns over the guests, though she doesn't mean anything she's saying. Once in a while, she shoots a glance in your direction.
You don't need reminding. You know why you've come to the auction.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: I'm going on stage. You okay on your own? Are you nervous?
McQueen whispers in your ear, her hand on your arm.
Just a bit uncomfortable with the identity you created for me.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Hahaha! There's no other solution. I can't just tell everyone that you're the Chief of the MBCC.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Sorry for putting you in such a position, pretending to be the plus one of the auctioneer and all.
McQueen seems amused by your pent-up uneasiness, an obvious smile playing on her lips.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Blend in with the crowd and enjoy the show.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: And you'll see for yourself if the art world is beyond salvation, just like I said it is.
She rolls up her sleeve to show her mark of shackles.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Don't worry. I'm not gonna run away.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Well, I know you're not here to listen to my babble. So let's get down to business.
McQueen's voice brings you out of your trance.
She claps her hands. Presently, two paintings, each covered with a cloth, are carried onto the stage.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: The first painting for auction today... the artist, unknown; the name of the painting, also unknown. But I took the liberty of giving it a name...

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: The Rising Sun
McQueen unveils one of the paintings. It depicts a rising sun over a lake.
The painting is a vibrant combination of colors. It appears to you on a visceral level, for it is so full of life and energy.
The reaction of the room, however, is lukewarm.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Let's see what we got here. It's evident that the artist's understanding of colors deviates from the norm. Color saturation is too high; the use of oil paint is too liberal. It looks like a childish doodle compared to the masterpieces by some of our greatest artists.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: However, the colors go well with the unrestrained, broad strokes. The painting looks strangely harmonious as a whole. And the rising sun, so intense that its shape goes distorted. It is a prime symbol of life force.
McQueen describes the painting, somewhat engrossed, but her speech sparks only sporadic applause among the attendees.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: We'd like to start the bidding on this painting at 1 million DisCoins. Any taker?
The applause comes to a sudden halt. Whispers start here and there, but for a long time, no one makes a bid.
1 million DisCoins for a painting of unknown origin... Even you, an amateur, find the price outrageous.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Not interested? What if... this painting is from DisSea?

steps.speaker: Participant
steps.content: DisSea?
The hall comes to life.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: The Death Zone, where BR-000 appeared, and this painting, The Rising Sun, so full of life... Don't you think this makes a good story?
The atmosphere changes. The attendees look at the painting differently now.
Some attendees are tempted to raise their bid cards. The painting is waiting for its first bidder.
But unfortunately, they don't think the painting is worth 1 million DisCoins. No bid card is raised.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: It's understandable, considering that 1 million DisCoins is more than enough to compensate for the death of a combatant on a broken frontline, right?
McQueen's joke is in bad taste but goes down well. Like a talk-show audience, the attendees start roaring with laughter.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: No matter. We haven't got to the real meat of this auction yet. Look over here.
McQueen points at the other painting, still covered.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen, I have the honor of presenting to you another painting...
McQueen pauses for a deliberate moment, and once sure she's got everyone's undivided attention, she unveils the painting with a flourish.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: The Rising Sun!
The second painting is identical to the first one.
The same rising sun, the same lake, the same vibrant colors, the same unorthodox strokes...

steps.speaker: Participant A
steps.content: What?! Two identical paintings?

steps.speaker: Participant B
steps.content: The original and forgery in the same auction? What a complete farce!

steps.speaker: Participant C
steps.content: I can't see any difference. The copycat's no slouch. They are two of a kind!
The hall bursts into life. Some are looking through telescopes at the paintings for differences, while some are cussing at the absurdity of the situation.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Bingo! They are two of a kind.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: The second painting is a work by Maureen, an outstanding graduate of the art department of Keylan University. Ten years ago, her first work, A Hot Summer Day, was auctioned off at an astronomical number.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: She was hailed as the Princess of Landscapes, a great artist in the making. Five years ago, she got married and stopped painting, and she's stayed out of the public eye since. Ladies and gentlemen, you must have heard about her before, right?

steps.speaker: Participant
steps.content: Maureen?!
The hubbub is growing in intensity. The name Maureen, which is strange to you, is now on everyone's lips.

steps.speaker: Participant A
steps.content: 1 million 200 thousand, for the second painting!
The first bidder appears.

steps.speaker: Participant B
steps.content: 1 million 500 thousand, also for the second painting!

steps.speaker: Participant C
steps.content: 1 million 800 thousand!
More and more bidders... They all want the second painting, or the glory attached to its creator, to be precise.
Two identical paintings, but all they care about is who created them... Is this her way of telling me how superficial and shallow these collectors are?
It's straightforward but not convincing. You've lost interest in this farcical show McQueen's directing. You decide to leave the vying crowd.
But before you can stand up, the murmur of a woman in the corner catches your attention. She's talking to herself.
No, not yet. She promised me she'd get me a higher price.
She looks out of place in this extravagant crowd.
You're distracted for only a few seconds when an uproar breaks out in the hall. McQueen is making a new move on stage.

steps.speaker: Participant A
steps.content: She switched the paintings around?

steps.speaker: Participant B
steps.content: And she's still doing it? W-which is Maureen's painting?

steps.speaker: Participant C
steps.content: No idea. What's that for?

Amid cries of surprise, McQueen finally stops switching the paintings. She stands between the two identical paintings, and her playful gaze sweeps around the room, taking in every guest present, you included.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: I never said it's Maureen's painting that we're auctioning today.
Argh!
Accompanied by the screams of the woman in the corner, McQueen cuts one of the paintings to shreds in the blink of an eye.
A deadly silence descends on the crowd. Their mouths fall open, and their eyes are trained on the stage. You can't figure out why McQueen did what she did.

steps.speaker: Participant A
steps.content: The auctioneer, s-she destroyed the painting?

steps.speaker: Participant B
steps.content: Now there's only one The Rising Sun.

steps.speaker: Participant C
steps.content: Is it... the one from DisSea, or the one by Maureen?
The crowd can't believe what they've just seen. They stare at McQueen as she sheathes her blade, giving them an unbelievably brilliant smile.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen, let's get the auction properly started!

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: This painting can be the one from DisSea. It can be the one by Maureen that marks her forgery career. It's the one left from the two identical paintings.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Let the bidding for The Rising Sun begin. We'd like to start this bidding at... 30 million DisCoins!

steps.speaker: Participant
steps.content: 30 million?!

The quiet is broken; the hall descends into bedlam. With the exception of you and the woman in the corner, the guests become restless. Some of them are on the phone with banks, asking for money to be wired.
From 1 million to 30 million, a thirty-fold increase... That's preposterous. Are they really going to pay that kind of money for a painting even though they don't know who painted it?
Not preposterous at all. McQueen's just laid out the reasons.
The woman wends her way through the restless crowd to where you are. The way she looks at The Rising Sun is hard to understand.
A painting from DisSea, a painting that marks Maureen's forgery career, the one left from the two identical paintings... McQueen really knows what she's doing.
Are these name tags more important than the painting itself?
Yes...
The woman forces a smile.
What's painted is not important at all!
As if in response to the woman's words, voices making bids swell through the hall.

steps.speaker: Participant A
steps.content: 35 million!

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: 35 million, going once...

steps.speaker: Participant B
steps.content: 50 million!

steps.speaker: Participant C
steps.content: 65 million!

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: 65 million, going once...
As the bids go higher and higher, you experience a burning sensation in your hand, and in a reflex action, you look toward the stage.
McQueen is repeating back the bids enthusiastically, an eerie red light flashing in her eyes. You sense that her M-value is climbing.
The prelude has ended. The show she really wants you to see is underway.
Are you here to stop her? Could you... not do that?
The woman who has been staying in the corner now stands beside you.
It's my choice. I did it of my own accord.
Maureen nods. She is standing among an excited crowd of bidders but seems unaffected by the craziness around her.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Dear, one trip to the Belphegor Art Museum doesn't make you an expert on the art world.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: From top to bottom, from painter to buyer, the profession is rotten to the core.
Here comes the subplot of the grand show designed to show you the true colors of the art world.

steps.speaker: Maureen
steps.content: I want to be popular again, just like before I got married. I want to live a glamorous, extravagant life again.

steps.speaker: Maureen
steps.content: Please don't thwart this auction.
Maureen is standing on the path leading to the stage, between you and McQueen.
McQueen, the initiator of all this craziness, is receiving higher and higher bids. She stares down at you from the stage, as if anticipated.
You read McQueen's lips.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Do you still want to change this profession?
McQueen gets out a candlestick holding a lighted candle and touches lovingly the frame of the painting.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Like I've told you, it's not worth changing!
With a soft rumbling sound, a fire starts. The painting, now worth tens of millions of DisCoins, is burning right before McQueen's eyes.
No one can't wrap their head around what's happening. The shocked onlookers, the dumbfounded painters, and McQueen, the instigator of the chaos... A new wave of craziness sweeps across the hall.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Beauty is always fragile. A beautiful thing can be incomplete; it can be destroyed; it can be hidden away... Tragedy, in contrast, is the ultimate art that will never die.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: A one-of-a-kind painting in flames... Now, we'd like to start this bidding at...

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: 300 million DisCoins!
